item.title: Comment on Part Of New Tralee Northern Relief Road To Open On Monday by Eugene O' Brien
item.description: This project is a disgrace. The road is too narrow. The 4th exit at Listellick will connect to the Bracket road only causing a huge backlog of cars. After the Health and safety issues, they never bothered to extend the town sewer system above the Roundabout. Resignations required all round.

item.title: Comment on Part Of New Tralee Northern Relief Road To Open On Monday by Julia fealy
item.description: I wish to raise a road safety concern regarding the design and placement of a speed Bump on Killeen Road at the eastern end of the new Ring Road development near the Forge Roundabout I am a homeowner on the old Gurrane road The speed bump in question is a thick ramp style structure designed to allow for pedestrians and bicycle crossings the speed bump is to high and the junction is too narrow and dangerous
